lock.title: GoWorks Locked
lock.subtitle: Enter your master password to continue.
lock.pending: {{count}} operation(s) still running in the background.
lock.corrupt: The vault file can't be read. You may need to reset it.
lock.lockedOut: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{seconds}}s.

reauth.title: Google session couldn't be restored
reauth.subtitle: The vault is unlocked, but your Google session couldn't be refreshed automatically. Sign in again to continue.
reauth.note: This usually means the stored session key (refresh token) is no longer valid — for example after the OAuth client was changed. Signing in again resolves it permanently.

setup.title: Create a Master Password
setup.subtitle: Your sensitive keys (Service Account, session) are encrypted with this password and stored only on this device. There is no recovery if you forget it.
setup.tooShort: Password must be at least {{min}} characters.
setup.recommend: Tip: a 12+ character password is more secure.

reset.title: Reset vault
reset.warning: This deletes the master password and the encrypted keys. You'll need to re-upload the Service Account key and sign in to Google again. This can't be undone.
reset.warningDetailed: This CANNOT be undone. The following are permanently deleted: the master password and encrypted keys, the Service Account key, and the Google session (refresh token). After resetting you'll have to complete the setup wizard from scratch.

onboarding.title: Master Password
onboarding.description: The Service Account key and Google session token are encrypted with this master password and stored only on this computer.
onboarding.note: There is no recovery key: if you forget the password you'll have to re-upload the keys.

changePassword.title: Change Master Password
changePassword.description: Verify your current password and set a new one. Your encrypted keys (Service Account, session) are preserved — no re-upload needed.
